items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that axioms (A1) to (A7) imply axiom (B) on the behaviour of the theory under disjoint unions and products (statement lines 4946-4948). The proof (proof lines 4949-4991) derives the additive part from the Kunneth decomposition and verifies the multiplicative part by expressing the class of the diagonal of a product through the classes of the diagonals of the factors. H3: an explicit Kunneth computation, written out in full.
